written_results: Finite primitive identity: for (a,b)=1, mu(ga)mu(gb)=mu(a)mu(b)mu(g)^2 times 1_((g,ab)=1). Squareful and noncoprime cases remain explicit.
Finite localized Gram scales as G_R(ga,gb)=g^(-5/3)G_(R/g)(a,b); the physical cutoff is shifted, not replaced by a complete atom integral.
Entry bound 0<=G_R(m,n)<=c*(mn)^(-5/6), with c=G_4(1,1) and 0<c<9/25; exact zero for n>=4m.
Complete partition Gamma(log R)=D+P+Q+A+Z. Divisible rays P use n=2m or 3m and satisfy -10c<=P<=0 for the actual Mobius source.
Other pairs with gcd(m,n)^2>=m have full absolute mass at most 45c. Pairs with gcd^2<m and (n-m)^2<=m have full absolute mass at most 14c.
Remaining core Z retains exactly m<n<4m, gcd(m,n)^2<m and (n-m)^2>m, with both ordered signs and finite cutoff.
Gamma(log R)<=Z(R)+(123/2)c and Z(R)<=Gamma(log R)+69c. Thus sup_J Z(2^J)<=C implies H_(1/3)(T)<=123*(C+(123/2)c) for all real T>=0; converse follows from Gamma<=8H.
Finite prime-pair lower bound: with K primes in (X,5X/4] and H=ceil(sqrt(5X/4)), Z_+(2X)>=K*max(0,K-1-2H)*X^(-5/3)/1296.
Finite prime--twice-prime lower bound: for X>=4, Z_-(4X)>=K*(K-1)*X^(-5/3)/2880. Both sign masses diverge by the unconditional PNT. No explicit numerical PNT onset is claimed.
Divergence of both sign masses rejects unsigned and positive-part suppliers for the actual source, not the signed-core target or RH.
